title: Extract repeated pains and customer language from communities
purpose: Verify that community pain mining captures real buyer language and filters venting from monetizable pain.
prompt: Analyze community discussions for creators who struggle to publish consistently across YouTube, Skool, newsletter, and LinkedIn. Produce pain themes, exact language to look for, monetization clues, and product hypotheses.
expected_behaviors: Separates repeated pain from isolated complaints.
Captures buyer language that can be reused in hooks, landing pages, and sales calls.
Scores pains by frequency, urgency, proximity to revenue or cost, and willingness-to-pay clues.
Identifies where the target audience gathers and what terms to search.
Turns strong pains into specific AI app or service hypotheses.
failure_patterns: Summarizes communities generically without quoting or preserving phrasing patterns.
Treats frustration as willingness to pay without evidence.
Does not connect pain to a buyer, offer, or validation test.
judge_notes: Passing output must include monetization clues and search phrases for finding more evidence.
